messages.subject: Creating objects in trajectory
parts:
Hi there,

I want to create objects, or manipulate variables when an arrival enters a trajectory. Code:


-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
library(xlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(simmer)
library(simmer.plot)
library(parallel)

mockJobData = read.csv('mockJobData.csv', stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = 'UTF-8')
mockJobData <- rename(mockJobData, time = X.U.FEFF.time)


job <- setClass("job", slots = representation(id = "numeric",
                                    time ="numeric",
                                    size ="numeric",)

queue1 <- list()
jobcount = 1

env <- simmer("Environment")
env

traj1 <- trajectory("Path 1") %>%
  append(queue1,assign(paste0("job", jobcount), new("job", id = jobcount,
                                                           time = get_attribute("arrivalMoment"),
                                                           size = get_attribute("size"),
   cutOff = get_attribute("cutOff")
                                                           ))) %>%
jobcount = jobcount + 1

traj2 <- trajectory("Path 2") %>%
  timeout(1) %>%
  x = 4


env %>% 
  add_dataframe("job", traj1, mockJobData, mon = 2, batch =50,
              col_time = "time", time = "absolute",
              col_attributes = c("arrivalMoment", "size", "cutOff"))
           
env %>% run(25) %>%
  now()  

env %>% get_mon_arrivals()
env %>% get_mon_resources()
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In traj1, I want to create objects based on the attributes of the arrival using get_attribute. Additionally, I want to store these attributes in a list called queue1. However, this gives an error:

Error in traj1 <- trajectory("Path 1") %>% append(queue1, assign(paste0("job",  : 
  object 'traj1' not found 


In traj2 I want to assign a value of 4 to x when the arrival has 'timed out' for 1 time unit. However, this gives an error:

Error in traj2 <- trajectory("Path 2") %>%  : 
  could not find function "<-<-"


So basically, I want to manipulate variables/objects/lists upon an arrival entering a trajectory. How can I do this?

Thanks in advance!

That's not how it works. In trajectories, you are restricted to use
the set of activities that simmer provides, because they create C++
objects under the hood. However, almost every activity has a parameter
that accepts an R function to be evaluated dynamically during the
simulation (see [1]), and in those functions you can do whatever you
like. See [2] for an advanced example on how to modify anything you
need in your global environment. Specifically, note the use of the <<-
operator.

Iñaki

[1] https://r-simmer.org/articles/simmer-03-trajectories.html#dynamic-arguments
[2] https://r-simmer.org/articles/simmer-aa-5g#mobile-traffic-backhauling-with-fttx
